THE CLAIMSHIELD METHOD
01 / LOCK

Same terms. Same version.

Publisher-scoped policy and evidence URLs point to a full Git commit. SHA-256 commitments reject altered content.

02 / ASSESS

Independent interpretation.

GenLayer validators retrieve sources and separately evaluate coverage, exclusions and incident support. Critical findings must agree.

03 / CHALLENGE

A reason you can inspect.

Exact quotations and decision hashes remain in history. A claim party can submit new evidence for one further review.

Source control is not real-world authenticity. The current publisher is a project-owned GitHub namespace, not a verified insurer. This release supports public UTF-8 text evidence. Human review, private evidence, insurer attestations and production validation remain adoption work.
